title: Worst-case cost recurrence bound
statement: For every $d\in\mathbb{N}$, the worst-case expected query cost of the level-$d$ randomized tree is at most $\max(F_d,T_d)$, where the real sequences $F_d$ and $T_d$ are defined by $F_0=T_0=1$, $F_{d+1}=2T_d$, and $T_{d+1}=F_d+T_d/2$.
